item.title: Formal Complaint – Accumulation of Rubbish, Crows and Environmental Nuisance on Burham Close, Penge, 10th October
item.description:
Complain about the ongoing accumulation of rubbish on Burham Close, Penge, and the serious nuisance this is creating for local residents. Every day, rubbish from the surrounding area is being accumulated at this location. The waste is then being repeatedly torn into and scattered by a large colony of crows that has established itself around the site because of the constant availability of food. Rather than the birds moving elsewhere, the daily accumulation of rubbish is effectively providing them with a permanent food source. This is creating an unpleasant and increasingly unsanitary environment for residents. Rubbish is being spread around the surrounding area, attracting birds and potentially other pests, while also creating an obvious eyesore. What is particularly concerning is that the location being used for the local rubbish collection is directly underneath a warning regarding fly-tipping. It is extremely difficult for residents to understand the message being sent here. On the one hand, residents are warned not to dump rubbish, while on the other hand a significant amount of waste is being routinely accumulated at the same location. This does not set a particularly good example of how the area should be managed. The situation is even more concerning given the closure of the Blenheim Centre. The surrounding area already feels considerably more neglected and sinister than it did previously, We are residents, not a dumping ground.

Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): 3, Burham Close, Penge, Greater London
Report on FixMyStreet
